parlays.name: Value 2
parlays.why: The main pick: two legs from different games, each worth its price on its own where a real price is known. Two legs keep the bookmaker's margin small (about 9% at standard prices against about 24% for six).

legs.note: pinnacle main line, blended halfway with the market
legs.story: Kings to stay close or win: the Magic are without Jalen Suggs; the Kings are at home.
Over on the total: the Jazz and the Heat like to play fast; the Jazz are without Keyonte George and Jaren Jackson Jr., so they defend with a thinner, weaker rotation.

parlays.story: Built around the Kings against a Magic side without Jalen Suggs and a high-scoring game between the Heat and the Jazz. Every leg comes from a different game, so one surprise result cannot sink two legs at once.

parlays.name: Core 3
parlays.why: Three legs from three different games: the strongest combination of chance and value without stacking one game.

parlays.name: The daily 6
parlays.why: The long shot: six legs, at most two per game. It pays big but lands rarely, and the bookmaker's margin compounds over six legs, so it needs every leg to carry real value. Treat it as the optional extra, not the main bet.
